units.summary: The company implemented a UiPath RPA bot for matching supplier invoices to purchase orders in Business Central. The notes distinguish this rule-based automation from AI.
units.quote: An RPA bot (UiPath) was implemented in 2023 for matching supplier invoices to purchase orders in Business Central. Works for ~70 % of invoices; the rest go to manual handling. This is rule-based, not AI, but it is the company's main automation experience.
